== Sample Wiki Page ==

This is a sample '''MediaWiki''' (Wikitext) page to demonstrate the viewer capabilities.

=== Text Formatting ===

You can make text '''bold''' using three apostrophes.

You can make text ''italic'' using two apostrophes.

You can make text '''''bold and italic''''' using five apostrophes.

=== Lists ===

; Unordered list:
* Item 1
* Item 2
** Nested item 2.1
** Nested item 2.2
* Item 3

; Ordered list:
# First item
# Second item
## Nested item 2.1
## Nested item 2.2
# Third item

; Definition list:
; Term 1 : Definition 1
; Term 2 : Definition 2

=== Links ===

External link: https://example.com

External with text: [https://github.com GitHub]

Internal link: [[Main Page]]

Internal with display text: [[Main Page|Go to Main Page]]

=== Code ===

Inline code: <code>console.log("Hello")</code>

Code block:

<pre>
function greet(name) {
  return "Hello, " + name + "!";
}
</pre>

=== Tables ===

{| class="wikitable"
! Name !! Type !! Value !! Description
|-
| Item 1 || A || 100 || First item
|-
| Item 2 || B || 200 || Second item
|-
| Item 3 || C || 300 || Third item
|}

=== Blockquote ===

<blockquote>
This is a blockquote example. It can span multiple lines and is useful for quotations.
</blockquote>

=== Combined Example ===

Here's a paragraph with '''bold''', ''italic'', and [[Internal Link|links]] all together.

* List item with '''bold text'''
* Another item with ''italic''
* Item with a [https://example.com link]

<pre>
Code can appear anywhere
function example() {
  return true;
}
</pre>

=== Escaping ===

Use <nowiki>{{{this}}}</nowiki> to prevent template parsing.

Normal text without parsing: <nowiki>{{{no template here}}}</nowiki>
